_about: Webhook and real-time event model, hand-kept from the docs pages in each source. Re-check when the nightly job reports a source page changed.

fields: Delivery name. Same as bot_event except on an ending, where it is always bot.stopped.
The specific event. Branch on this; fall back to event when it is missing (resends, older payloads).
Status at this point. Compare case-insensitively (Error, ERROR, Failed, FAILED).
Human text. Failures start with Error: (bot could not continue) or Failed: (meeting, host or lobby decided).
A hint, not the outcome (200 or 500). Some endings omit it.
ISO 8601 on status events; some post-call events omit it; changes on resend.
Echo of what you set on create_bot.
Google Meet only, on bot.failed when the meeting blocked the join.

notes: bot.joining can arrive more than once for scheduled bots.
bot.in_waiting_room is sent even when the bot is admitted at once.
bot.inmeeting arrives at most once per bot.

rows: Meeting ended, everyone left, automatic leave, removed through the API, Zoom recording permission denied or timed out
A host or participant removed the bot (same bot_status as a clean exit)
The host rejected the join, or the platform refused
gotchas: A bot removed before it joins moves to Stopped, and on Zoom and Google Meet no ending event follows: mark it ended when remove_bot succeeds.
Many Zoom join failures end as Stopped: success needs bot.inmeeting and an empty ErrorReason on /detail.
A bot stuck in Joining for about 60 minutes ends NotAllowed (JoinTimeout).
Google Meet failure_reason values: invalid_meeting_link, meeting_not_started, meeting_ended, meeting_restricted, sign_in_required, google_sign_in_failed, cant_join_call, admission_not_confirmed.

rows: No audio or no valid provider config
Everything finished (finished, not succeeded); also sent for bots that never got in

Non-fatal in-meeting problem (for example a live transcription provider failed), or a scheduled bot rejected at start (ScheduledDispatchRejected, StorageValidationFailed, InsufficientCredits). Workspace endpoints only.
MIA voice agent problem. Workspace endpoints only.
Real-time participant events. Subscribe with recording_config.realtime_endpoints.
Google Meet and Zoom; only to realtime_endpoints that list them, never to workspace webhooks.
Account usage notices. Workspace endpoints only.
Media deleted (retention or DELETE /api/v1/bots/{bot_id}/delete); status becomes MediaExpired.
other_events.note: Unknown event names can appear: ignore them, do not fail.

rules: Workspace endpoints (dashboard, up to 10, event filter) are signed: X-MeetStream-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, keyed with the endpoint secret>. X-MeetStream-Timestamp is not part of the signed content.
Per-bot callback_url deliveries are not signed. Live-transcript POSTs are not signed: put a secret token in the URL and check that bot_id is yours.
Each event is delivered once, with no automatic retry. Resend by hand from the endpoint's Logs tab (up to 10 times).
Reply 2xx within 5 seconds, then process. Poll GET /bots/{bot_id}/status as a fallback for bots in Joining or Scheduled.
De-duplicate on (bot_id, bot_event or event). Do not de-duplicate bot.joining or participant_events.* on that key (repeats are normal).
Post-call events arrive in any order; bot.done is last.
transcript_id is in no webhook: read it from the create_bot response or GET /bots/{bot_id}/detail.
Since 12 Nov 2026, post-call webhooks go only to public addresses.

notes: No event key in the payload.
A streaming provider needs live_transcription_required.webhook_url (400 without it).
The bot connects to your WebSocket server (template a server, not a client).
First message: JSON ready. Then binary PCM16 little-endian frames.
Byte 0 is the frame type: 0x01 = 48 kHz mono; 0x04 = header with sample rate and channel count (Zoom uses 32 kHz). Google Meet sends both: check byte 0 on every frame.
control_socket: socket_connection_url: send sendaudio, sendmsg (include message and msg), sendimg, interrupt, resume_audio.
On Zoom and Teams, interrupt blocks later audio until resume_audio.
not_live: Per-participant audio and video are files after the call.
